_metadata.purpose: Tenants on a shared platform host (a Salesforce org, a campaign host) that a vendor operates for many unrelated institutions. A detection whose every host-anchored match (Script, or DOM with a host) is on a host listed here is the vendor's, not the institution's.
_metadata.ruling: Joel 2026-11-16 (detection review, ruling 1): vendor-operated tenants are RECORDED but never user-facing. The engine detects them like any other tenant; the producer marks the detection `operatedBy`; the loader keeps the row in institution_technologies with evidence.operated_by and institution_tech_ranked / LedgerProfileService exclude it. Never deleted as noise, and never excluded inside a pattern regex (this file replaces the hard-coded `(?!spanside\.|uniquest)` lookahead in the Salesforce rules).
_metadata.entry: {host, match: exact|suffix, operator, technologies: [names] | "*", ruling: "vendor_operated", reason, decided: YYYY-MM-DD, decider, seen?: {cohort, institutions}}. `suffix` matches the host itself and any subdomain of it. `seen` is the evidence the entry was decided on.
_metadata.reader: src/shared-tenants.js (operatorForHosts, validateRegistry); tests/shared-tenants.test.js validates this file.
_metadata.evidence: ~/LLM/speedyu-data/detechtor-review-2026-11/ (FINDINGS.md findings 4-5; host -> institution lists from the cohort-143 corpus).
